name: evo
description: Evolving memory for agents: recall before the model thinks, reflect after it answers.

interface.shortDescription: Memory that recalls before the model thinks
interface.longDescription: Recalls durable global and project memory into every session, and distils each finished turn back into it. Storage is one local SQLite file; reflection runs through the Codex CLI you already have, so evo needs no API key of its own. Use $evo-browse to list all remembered skills and memories.

List the skills available through evo.
